titre: Devoir de synthèse n°3 - Anglais (7ème année de base)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Amira loves animals. She has a dog, a cat and two birds at home. Every day, she gives them food and water and plays with them. Amira wants to become a veterinarian (an animal doctor) when she grows up. Last week, she found a small injured bird in the garden. She took care of it for several days: she put it in a warm box and gave it food. After a few days, the bird was strong again and flew away. Amira was a little sad, but she was happy to help the bird. She believes that we must protect all animals.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (6 marks)
1) What animals does Amira have at home?   (1,5 marks)
2) What does she want to become in the future?   (1,5 marks)
3) What did she do with the injured bird?   (1,5 marks)
4) Why was Amira "a little sad" but "happy"?   (1,5 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put the verbs in the past simple: She (find) ______ a bird and (take) ______ care of it.   (2 marks)
2) Complete with "must / mustn't": We ______ protect animals.   (1,5 marks)
3) Give the opposite of "strong" = ______.   (1,5 marks)
4) Find in the text a word that means "an animal doctor" = ______.   (1 mark)

III. WRITING (8 marks)
Do you like animals? Write about your favourite animal or a time you helped an animal (about 10 lines). Say why animals are important and how we can protect them. Use the present simple and the past simple.
